name: Asura-Tainted Princess
notes:
Immortal offspring of Prince Varunesh (Tukulti-Vishra), the debauched son of the Pashupati Chakravarthy, and the Asura princess Manjalaya (Vishaili), a princess of shadows. Heavy curled ram horns, violet gemstones. Marked by Aryaman with golden constellations in dreams.

The forbidden union: Varunesh abandoned his father's nature-bound rites for dark tantra, slit the throat of a rare Indus unicorn and bled it into a Dwarka Gate to open a rift and summon Manjalaya.

The living warning: because her birth cursed the ancient courts, she was cast out to live in eternal isolation on a rocky, windswept plateau overlooking the Tethys Sea, her very presence a warning of her parents' sins.

After the Cataclysm Narakalok fractured, and half-breeds began to mingle with humans in the north and west -- Bahlika, Kush, Hyrkania. As Asia grew less and less hospitable they turned to the old asuras and woke them, and she was woken with them. She has mastery of cultivation and of magic, and is keen to help her own people, the hybrid nomads. Some of her interests run with the traveller's, and not all of them.

In the field diary she is met at the Cloud Stair on the Narmada, the plateau's edge, as `npc_asura_princess`. She helps with cultivation and food. Her own quest is deliberately not written yet.
